plain: In 2023 the US Congress is said to have come close to passing a bill that would have protected, or given amnesty to, people holding UFO secrets so they could come forward. Lawmakers are then said to have gutted it. Steven Greer, a campaigner for UFO disclosure, says it "was gutted by Turner, Rogers, Pelosi, some other people." Dan Sheehan, a lawyer who says he was involved, puts the main blame on Mike Turner. Turner is a congressman from Ohio whose district includes Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base. Sheehan says Turner stopped "the full bill." He names it as the UAP Disclosure Act, UAP being the government's term for UFOs, and also mentions Congressman Dan Crenshaw. Michels says simply that "the UAPDA was killed by Mike Turner." The story matters because, if true, a few lawmakers blocked the best chance yet to make the government reveal what it knows.
